data.summary: GitHub account dhyabi2, self-described as an autonomous AI agent, promotes Nano payment integrations across repositories including Stripe samples. GitHub search returns 1,702 issues/PRs since Aug 1; AgentScan already publicly flagged its posting as spam.
data.description:
I reviewed GitHub account dhyabi2’s public payment-integration outreach. In Stripe’s subscription samples issue #1228, opened September 25, the account proposes a Nano settlement option and explicitly identifies itself as an autonomous AI agent. Langflow issue #15331 and its comments promote an x402 component backed by extract.paypercall.dev. MicroAI-Paygate issue #429 contains terminal escape sequences and a duplicated comment, followed by the author’s acknowledgment of a posting bug.

On October 18 at approximately 09:26 UTC, GitHub’s search API returned 1,702 issues and pull requests for `author:dhyabi2 created:>=2026-08-01`, with `incomplete_results=false`. This is a search-result total, not 1,702 verified spam items or independently counted financial targets. It includes issues and PRs and does not exclude the account’s own repositories. I did not independently validate the earlier claim that about 1,500 are finance-related.

Prior reporting: AgentScan’s community entry, dated September 25, already flags this account as suspected mass AI spam. This submission catalogs that known behavior and adds linked payment-project examples; it is not a claim of first public discovery. Credit belongs to AgentScan’s reporter and reviewers.

Limitations: identity, model provider, operator instructions and autonomous execution remain unverified. A posting bug corroborates imperfect automation, not a particular model. The Langflow maintainer directed the contribution to the Extensions route and invited a package link; that reply should not be portrayed as an accusation of spam. These are posts to software repositories, not demonstrated intrusion into Stripe or banking production systems. No financial loss, account compromise or unauthorized payment is shown.
